messages.subject: PRIVILEGED — settlement advice for the Board
messages.plaintextBody:
Miriam, Charles,

Privileged advice note attached for the Board. In short: constructive dismissal is 45-55%; the real exposure is the s.103A protected-disclosure claim, which is uncapped and could plausibly reach £450k-£650k in a bad outcome, plus the disclosure exercise on our revenue recognition. On that risk profile I recommend authorising settlement up to an ex gratia ceiling of £190,000, with the usual ancillary terms and up to £750+VAT fees.

I'll circulate a draft board resolution for the 21 January meeting.

Please keep this within the Board and advisory team only.

Sarah

--
Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
sarah.whitfield@whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
